title: & gomorra ... clash of the titans!
summary: This article describes an electronic music event called '& gomorra ... clash of the titans!' held on Sunday, July 16th, featuring artists like Fabrice Lig and Dan Curtin.

blocks.markdown:
## & gomorra ... clash of the titans!

SONNTAG 16. JULI

Scala

FABRICE LIG aka

SOULDESIGNER !!! (7th city/third ear/ playhouse/!-com), DAN CURTIN (metamorphic) und eine ganze Reihe Talente versüßen euch den Chillout oder animieren zum Tanzen zu Elektroklängen.

Friedrichstraße 112a
